title.zh: 评级巨头 S&P Global 收购 OpenZeppelin，推进代币化金融风险布局
title.en: Ratings giant S&P Global acquires OpenZeppelin in tokenized finance risk push

current_state.zh: 标普全球已完成对 OpenZeppelin 的收购，后者作为独立业务部门以 OpenZeppelin 名称运营，由创始人 Demian Brener 领导并向标普全球评级总裁 Yann Le Pallec 汇报；财务条款未披露。
current_state.en: S&P Global has closed its acquisition of OpenZeppelin, which operates as a standalone business unit under the OpenZeppelin name, led by founder Demian Brener reporting to S&P Global Ratings president Yann Le Pallec; financial terms were not disclosed.

updates.title_zh: 评级巨头 S&P Global 收购 OpenZeppelin，推进代币化金融风险布局
updates.title_en: Ratings giant S&P Global acquires OpenZeppelin in tokenized finance risk push
updates.what_changed_zh: S&P Global 已收购智能合约安全公司 OpenZeppelin，以应对代币化金融中银行和资产管理公司面临的技术风险，此前该公司曾投资市场数据提供商 Kaiko。
updates.what_changed_en: S&P Global has acquired smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin to address technological risks facing banks and asset managers in tokenized finance, following its earlier investment in market-data provider Kaiko.
updates.current_state_zh: S&P Global 已收购智能合约安全公司 OpenZeppelin，以应对代币化金融中银行和资产管理公司面临的技术风险，此前该公司曾投资市场数据提供商 Kaiko。
updates.current_state_en: S&P Global has acquired smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin to address technological risks facing banks and asset managers in tokenized finance, following its earlier investment in market-data provider Kaiko.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: S&P Global has acquired smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin to address technological risks facing banks and asset managers in tokenized finance, following its earlier investment in market-data provider Kaiko.
updates.detailed_summary_en: S&P Global has acquired smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin to address technological risks facing banks and asset managers in tokenized finance, following its earlier investment in market-data provider Kaiko.

updates.title_zh: S&P Global 同意收购 OpenZeppelin，推进链上安全布局
updates.title_en: S&P Global agrees to acquire OpenZeppelin in onchain security push
updates.what_changed_zh: 该交易是收购协议而非已完成收购，OpenZeppelin 将作为 S&P Global 的独立业务部门运营，财务条款未披露。
updates.what_changed_en: The deal is an agreement to acquire rather than a completed acquisition, and OpenZeppelin will operate as a standalone business unit under S&P Global; financial terms were not disclosed.
updates.current_state_zh: S&P Global 已同意收购 OpenZeppelin，后者将作为独立业务部门运营；财务条款未披露。
updates.current_state_en: S&P Global has agreed to acquire OpenZeppelin, which will operate as a standalone business unit; financial terms were not disclosed.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: S&P Global has agreed to acquire smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin, which will operate as a standalone business unit, marking a notable traditional finance push into onchain security infrastructure.
updates.detailed_summary_en: S&P Global has agreed to acquire smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin, which will operate as a standalone business unit, marking a notable traditional finance push into onchain security infrastructure.

updates.title_zh: 【标普全球完成收购区块链安全公司 OpenZeppelin】
updates.title_en: 【标普全球完成收购区块链安全公司 OpenZeppelin】
updates.what_changed_zh: 标普全球已完成对 OpenZeppelin 的收购（此前仅为收购协议）；OpenZeppelin 以独立业务部门运营，创始人 Demian Brener 领导并向标普全球评级总裁 Yann Le Pallec 汇报，OpenZeppelin Contracts 库继续保持开源免费维护。
updates.what_changed_en: S&P Global has completed its acquisition of OpenZeppelin (previously only an agreement to acquire); OpenZeppelin operates as a standalone unit led by founder Demian Brener reporting to S&P Global Ratings president Yann Le Pallec, with the OpenZeppelin Contracts library remaining open source and freely maintained.
updates.current_state_zh: 标普全球已完成对 OpenZeppelin 的收购，后者作为独立业务部门以 OpenZeppelin 名称运营，由创始人 Demian Brener 领导并向标普全球评级总裁 Yann Le Pallec 汇报；财务条款未披露。
updates.current_state_en: S&P Global has closed its acquisition of OpenZeppelin, which operates as a standalone business unit under the OpenZeppelin name, led by founder Demian Brener reporting to S&P Global Ratings president Yann Le Pallec; financial terms were not disclosed.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: S&P Global has closed its acquisition of blockchain security firm OpenZeppelin, which will operate as an independent unit under founder Demian Brener reporting to S&P Global Ratings president Yann Le Pallec, with the OpenZeppelin Contracts library remaining open source and freely maintained.
updates.detailed_summary_en: S&P Global has closed its acquisition of blockchain security firm OpenZeppelin, which will operate as an independent unit under founder Demian Brener reporting to S&P Global Ratings president Yann Le Pallec, with the OpenZeppelin Contracts library remaining open source and freely maintained.
updates.background_zh: OpenZeppelin Contracts 被广泛视为 ERC-20 和 ERC-721 代币实现方面的行业标准合约库，支撑着相当大一部分 DeFi 与代币化资产基础设施。标普全球一直在拓展其数字资产覆盖范围，此次交易将 OpenZeppelin 的链上安全技术与标普全球的机构客户网络和全球分销能力结合起来。
updates.background_en: OpenZeppelin Contracts is widely used as the industry-standard library for ERC-20 and ERC-721 token implementations, underpinning a large share of DeFi and tokenized asset infrastructure. S&P Global has been expanding its digital asset coverage, and the deal pairs OpenZeppelin's onchain security tooling with S&P Global's institutional client network and global distribution.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该交易将一家主要评级机构与众多稳定币和代币化基金所依赖的合约库连接起来，可能把传统风险评估与评级框架延伸至代币化资产发行方及其上线平台。其影响主要通过机构尽职调查与分销渠道传导，而非通过代币供给或链上流动性。
updates.market_impact_en: The deal links a major ratings agency to the code libraries behind many stablecoins and tokenized funds, which could extend traditional risk-assessment and ratings frameworks into tokenized-asset issuers and the venues that list them. Any effect would run through institutional due-diligence and distribution channels rather than through token supply or onchain liquidity.
